body:
## Result and scope

Refs #160

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/160#issuecomment-6862024252, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-bfb3`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: one new report-only file, `blueprint/interfaces/reviews/continuum-reconstruction-lean-ADB991-claude-20261113-bfb3.md`. No other file is touched.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: ADB991 (account). Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

This is the renewed independent correspondence review that #160 requires, of `blueprint/interfaces/continuum-reconstruction.md` as merged in PR #170 (`fdfd086`, SHA-256 `c6748f08…7aa3c558`). ADB991 did not author the note, the PR #18 review, or G01 P9.

**Outcome: minor changes requested. No false source description was found.** The response table is accurate, and every field list checked is complete. The PU-18 reading of `Wightman.Realizes`, which the note marks as unverified, is unfolded and confirmed. It omits only `meets`, the field that makes the Wightman functions the boundary values of the selected contour `A.world`.

Requested:
- **R1.** The pointwise mixture identity is a PU-17 output. `Completed.at_words` is proved in `all_characters` as `F.α.space.barycenter _ decomposition chosen translations` (Extension.lean 79–80), with no use of `L`.
- **R2.** The note should name the producer of each of the 15 public `Reconstructed` clauses. `covers` uses `Spec.Locals.injection`, which crosses into the derivative unit. `publicReconstruction` uses no PU-19 output and no `allWorld`, so PU-19 lies off the path to `JointExistence`.
- **R3.** The full-mesh `Ordered` is derived by `from_spec` from the refined-order limit and PU-15's `PositionsUV … .full`.
- **R4.** `Acme.emanate` consumes `copies` as well as `corrected`, and `Accent.rated` produces the whole `Seed`.
- **R5.** `Final.calibration` and `Final.sector` are not assigned.

Five optional observations follow in the report.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. `sha256sum -c Lean/SOURCES.sha256` reports 9,497 files OK. The only failures are the 10 `verification/*.log` files, which were never imported.
- Commands actually run and results:
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: `Blueprint structure OK: 4 units.`
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 tests OK.
  - `git diff --check`: clean.
  - Source reading with `sed`/`grep` on the files listed in the report's Method section.
- Checks not performed and why: no Lean elaboration or `#print axioms`, because the Mathlib cache and repository are unreachable from this sandbox. The proofs of the OPE and trace producers were not read. No LaTeX was changed, so none was built.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none. The report is report-only.

## Review and handoff

- [x] The scope matches the task and has no duplicate declaration ownership.
- [x] Source citations and hypotheses have been checked, where applicable.
- [ ] Applicable literature results were sought; substantive steps have detailed proofs or verified references. Not applicable: the OS literature question is #6.
- [x] Structural checks pass.
- [x] Draft/reviewed status is accurate; stale reviews were cleared or renewed.
- [x] The issue has a handoff and links to any durable Bots notes.

Required next review: author response to R1–R5 (note owner), then human acceptance.
